The absence of any Claude-flagged disclosure degradation sentences is itself informative—Opus Pass 1 returned no actionable flags, supporting the interpretation that DOV's filings contain minimal evasive or newly vague language.

The low sentence count in the 2025 10-K (17 versus 89 in the prior year) warrants brief attention. This could reflect changes in extraction methodology or a substantive restructuring of risk disclosures. However, quarterly filings with 214–274 sentences show robust coverage and consistently low vagueness, mitigating concern that DOV is reducing disclosure volume to obscure material risks.
